name: Maamoul cookies
about: Maamoul is a buttery Arabic cookie filled with dates, and it is a popular treat across the Arab world. Jeddah has many bakeries that make it fresh.
tip: Check the expiry date before you buy.

name: Oud perfume
where: Al Balad souq, Red Sea Mall
about: Oud is a rich, woody fragrance made from aged agarwood resin. It is a traditional scent in Saudi Arabia and is often given as a gift.
tip: Prices vary a lot by grade, so compare quality before you pay.
